newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Universal folds in coffee, chocolate unit.
newsitem.headline: Universal folds in coffee, chocolate unit.

text.p: Universal Robina Corp had assumed all assets and liabilites of its wholly-owned subsidiary CFC Corp, documents submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday showed.
Corporate secretary Emmanuel Rojas said the integration was done "with the objective of maximising the utilisation of resources and optimising operating efficiencies."
CFC Corp makes instant coffee, chocolates and biscuits, while Univeral Robina is a major producer of branded snack foods, juices, candies and noodles.
Both companies are part of conglomerate JG Summit Holdings.
